title: PHY 104 - Simple Harmonic Motion Master CBT

questions.text: A particle executes SHM according to $x = 0.12\cos(10t+\pi/6)$. Determine its maximum speed.
questions.explanation: Maximum speed in SHM is v_max = Aω = 0.12 × 10 = 1.20 m/s.

questions.text: A body of mass 0.50 kg is attached to a spring of force constant 125 N/m. Determine its frequency.
A particle performs SHM with amplitude 0.20 m and frequency 2 Hz. Find its maximum acceleration.
questions.explanation: a_max = Aω² where ω = 2πf = 4π rad/s. Therefore a_max = 0.20(4π)² ≈ 31.6 m/s².

questions.text: The total mechanical energy of an oscillator is 25 J. If its kinetic energy at an instant is 9 J, determine its potential energy.
questions.explanation: Total energy = KE + PE. Hence PE = 25 − 9 = 16 J.

questions.text: A particle executes SHM with amplitude 10 cm. At what displacement are the kinetic and potential energies equal?
questions.explanation: KE = PE when x = A/√2 = 10/√2 = 7.07 cm.

questions.text: A spring extends 4 cm when a mass of 4 kg is suspended from it. Determine the spring constant.
questions.explanation: At equilibrium, mg = kx. Thus k = (4 × 9.8)/0.04 = 980 N/m.

questions.text: A particle executes SHM with amplitude 0.15 m. Its maximum speed is 3.0 m/s. Determine its angular frequency.
The displacement of a particle is given by $x = 0.10\cos(8t)$. Find the magnitude of its velocity when its displacement is 6 cm.
A particle has amplitude 8 cm. What fraction of its total energy is kinetic when its displacement is 4 cm?
A body oscillates with a period of 0.50 s. Determine its angular frequency.
A particle executes SHM with amplitude 0.25 m and angular frequency 6 rad/s. Determine its speed when its displacement is 0.15 m.
A simple pendulum has a period of 2.0 s. Determine its length. (Take g = 9.8 m/s².)
A 0.40 kg mass attached to a spring oscillates with amplitude 0.10 m and angular frequency 10 rad/s. Calculate the total mechanical energy.
A particle executes SHM with amplitude 12 cm. At what displacement is its kinetic energy equal to three times its potential energy?
questions.explanation: KE = 3PE ⇒ A² − x² = 3x² ⇒ A² = 4x² ⇒ x = A/2 = 6 cm.

questions.text: The motion of a particle is given by $x = 0.08\sin(25t)$. Determine the maximum acceleration.
A particle executes SHM with amplitude 0.20 m. Determine the ratio of kinetic energy to potential energy when its displacement is 0.10 m.
A 0.80 kg mass is suspended vertically from a spring of stiffness 320 N/m. Calculate the period of small oscillations.
A damped oscillator has an initial amplitude of 20 cm. After several oscillations its amplitude becomes 5 cm. Which statement is correct?
options: The oscillator is now in resonance.
questions.explanation: Damping reduces the mechanical energy through frictional or resistive forces.

questions.text: In forced oscillation, the amplitude becomes maximum when
options: the driving frequency equals the natural frequency.
questions.explanation: Maximum amplitude occurs at resonance when the driving frequency equals the natural frequency.

questions.text: Two identical pendulums are connected by a light spring. Energy is transferred periodically from one pendulum to the other. This phenomenon is known as
questions.explanation: Coupled oscillators exchange energy periodically due to the weak connection between them.
